HELP.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search for an answer to your question...

FAQ.ADD_PRODUCT: How to add a new product?
FAQ.ADD_PRODUCT_ANSWER: Go to Products menu, click 'Add New Product', fill in required details, then click Save.
FAQ.EDIT_PRODUCT: How to edit an existing product?
FAQ.EDIT_PRODUCT_ANSWER: Go to Products, find the product in the list, click the edit (pencil) icon, update the details, then click Save.
FAQ.MANAGE_STOCK_ANSWER: Go to Inventory section, you can add new stock batches, adjust quantities, and review the full stock movement history.
FAQ.LOW_STOCK_ANSWER: Automatic alerts appear for low stock products. Go to Inventory, review low stock items, and add new quantities via 'Add Batch'.
FAQ.EXPIRED_PRODUCTS_ANSWER: Go to Expiry Report, review expired products, and discard or return to supplier according to policy.
FAQ.DEMAND_PREDICTION_ANSWER: Go to Inventory > Demand Predictions to see forecasted demand for each product based on past sales, helping you plan purchases before you run out of stock.
FAQ.CREATE_SALE_ANSWER: Open Point of Sale (POS), search for products, add them to cart, then complete the sale by selecting payment method.
FAQ.RETURN_SALE_ANSWER: Go to Sales History, find the invoice, click 'Refund', select products to refund, then confirm.
FAQ.CREATE_PURCHASE_ORDER: How to create a purchase order?
FAQ.CREATE_PURCHASE_ORDER_ANSWER: Go to Purchases, click 'Create Purchase Order', choose a supplier and add the products and quantities you're ordering, then save. Once the order arrives, mark it received to add the stock automatically.
FAQ.MANAGE_SUPPLIERS_ANSWER: Go to Purchases > Suppliers to add, edit, or remove suppliers, and to reach them directly over WhatsApp from the supplier list.
FAQ.RECORD_PAYMENT_ANSWER: Go to Payments, click the payment form, choose the payment method (cash, card, wallet, etc.), fill in the amount and details, then submit.
FAQ.TRACK_EXPENSES_ANSWER: Go to Expenses to record and review operating costs like rent, utilities, and salaries separately from purchase orders and payments.
FAQ.GENERATE_REPORT_ANSWER: Go to Reports, select report type (sales, stock, financial, or expiry), set the time period, then click 'Generate Report'.
FAQ.ADD_USER: How to add a new user?
FAQ.ADD_USER_ANSWER: Go to Settings > Users (Admins only), click 'Add User', fill in their details and choose a role, then save.
FAQ.USER_ROLES: What are the different user roles?
FAQ.USER_ROLES_ANSWER: Admin has full access to everything. Manager can access sales, purchases, reports, payments, and expenses. Pharmacist can access products, inventory, sales, and purchases. Viewer can only see the dashboard.
FAQ.ENABLE_2FA_ANSWER: Go to Settings > Security, start the 2FA setup, scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the generated code to confirm. You'll be asked for a code on every future login.
FAQ.UNLOCK_ACCOUNT: An account got locked after failed login attempts - how do I unlock it?
FAQ.UNLOCK_ACCOUNT_ANSWER: Accounts lock automatically after too many failed login attempts. An Admin can unlock the account and reset the failed-attempts count from Settings > Users.
FAQ.BACKUP_DATA: How to back up my store's data?
FAQ.BACKUP_DATA_ANSWER: Go to Settings > Backup (Admins only) to export a copy of your store's data at any time.
FAQ.CHANGE_LANGUAGE: How to switch the app between Arabic and English?
FAQ.CHANGE_LANGUAGE_ANSWER: Click the language toggle in the top header (or in the login/register screen) to switch between Arabic and English at any time - the whole interface switches direction (RTL/LTR) automatically.
FAQ.MANAGE_NOTIFICATIONS_ANSWER: Click the bell icon in the header to view recent notifications, or go to Settings > Notifications to control what you get notified about.
